document.about: PeerJ 2018, Sørensen and Grzelak, 'New mud dragons from Svalbard', PMC6166639. Its Table 10 (p42) heads a column `Species name and` over `ID number`, the label's second line set over the rule under the header, which runs across the table. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-26 (#383): `ID number`, alone on its line with the header's rule under it, was taken for a banner underlined across the table, and named every column (`Locality / ID number`, `Depth / ID number`).
